Imaging techniques (i.e., ultrasound, CT, and MRI) are excellent assessment options, but each has drawbacks that require consideration. Muscle biopsies have several inherent limitations, but they provide unique insights into fiber typespecific responses and important hypertrophic implications that cannot be gleaned from other methods.
